products.product_description: Dark Chocolate with Cranberry, Roasted Nuts & Sea Salt, sold under brand Willit House. Each bar is wrapped in gold foil and then wrapped with a box. Each box contains 12 bars and each bar has a net weight 60 gram.
products.code_info: codes: C2215F, C2915F, D0215F, D0315F, D2815F, D3115F, E0415F. All have best by date of 05/31/16. The code C2215F breakdown as: The first letter is the month of manufacturing (A=April, B=May, C=June, etc). The first and second number are the dates of manufacture. The third and fourth number are the year of manufacture. The last letter is the location of manufacture.
products.reason_for_recall: Undeclared soy lecithin. Dark Chocolate with Cranberry, Roasted Nuts & Sea Salt contains soy lecithin but label does not declare soy.
